'''Notes:'''<br>
<sup>1</sup> Before(LoD/D2R): Any Sorceress skill excluding those which require level 30: Frozen Orb, Hydra, and Masteries.

<sup>2</sup> After (PD2): Any direct damage Sorceress skill (excludes Masteries, Armor/Shield Skills, Warmth, Teleport, Thunder Storm, and Enchant skills) except Inferno. The same skill will be chosen for both random affixes.

<sup>3</sup> This is not a normal affix range roll. The chance is 8% for skills with a cooldown, and 12% for skills without a cooldown.

<sup>4</sup> This is not a normal affix range roll. The skill level of the proc is based on the level requirement of the rolled skill: Level 1 and 6 skills cast Level 26, declining 1 per "row" to 22 for Level 30 skills.
